`core-pins-81f8d3f2.json` contains seven literal outputs captured by the independent PR #10 reviewer from real Nanite core at `81f8d3f2`, `internal/chat/context_client.go:330–376`, using the included input rows. Scenarios cover empty, session, project, chronological mixed scopes, whitespace/CRLF/Unicode/control/Markdown text, excluded turn rows and excluded foreign sessions/projects.

The test imports those rows into the plugin and calls its private always-ship HTTP handler. The fixture adapter maps `sa`/`sb` to `session-a`/`session-b` and `pa`/`pb` to `project-a`/`project-b` because the query fixture uses those identities. It preserves timestamps, order and content. The actual manifest title wraps the fetched body for comparison with the captured core section; no document renderer is claimed. Same-second core SQL ties have no defined order and are deliberately excluded from this parity corpus.
